About Abyssal Clash

Abyssal Clash is a free 3D fighting and building game you play right in your browser — no download needed. Start on Starter Island, talk to the islanders and set off to explore a huge ocean full of islands, real-world cities like New York, Tokyo and Paris, and five dangerous seas.

Fight through 200 levels and giant bosses, build walls, ramps and forts Fortnite-style, mine for gold and diamonds, sail your own boat, and merge your weapons to make them stronger. Level up to 10,000 and spend points on Attack, Defence and Stamina.

Play with friends online: chat, add friends, team up on the islands or battle real players in the PvP arena. Sign up for free and your progress is saved so you can play on any computer.
